Free datastore path: Postgres on the DigitalOcean VM as postgres_provider=self_hosted (docker, SSL, per-app database) so stamping never needs a paid Supabase plan
evidence: Free datastore path shipped and proven live. Default flipped to postgres_provider=neon; provision.py adopt_or_create_neon() adopts an unattached FREE Marketplace resource only after proving it is EMPTY (the one spare held 54 tables / 15 MB and was refused and disconnected), otherwise runs 'vercel integration add neon' — verified EXIT=0 with no checkout page. Both branches exercised on a throwaway app #2 (state since deleted). End to end on the new free Neon db: schema push -> migration journal -> RLS/app_rw bootstrap -> retarget seam -> {"user":"app_rw","bypassrls":false,"policies":17,"sslmode":"require","plaintext":"refused","guc":"__probe__"} -> DATABASE_URL set on 3 projects -> task-workflow schema is ready. self_hosted implemented LOOPBACK-FREE: postgres:17 on a private docker network, port 6543 inside the container (so .bootstrap-supabase.mjs:206 is a no-op), no host port ever - same chain green with pg_stat_ssl true. Also fixed in the same pass: the phantom SUPABASE_URL gate (name exists nowhere in the mold yet blocked every non-Supabase deploy), the missing 'vercel project add' before env writes to {proj}-api, push-before-migrate ordering, admin_url() chain in provision.py and clone.py, --set-secret KeyError on non-Vercel apps, and infra/vm/apps/<id>/ now regenerated from state every run.

title: Fresh databases run as role postgres (BYPASSRLS): create app_rw and point DATABASE_URL at it after restore so RLS fail_closed holds (health endpoint warns)
evidence: app_rw is now proven, not assumed. bootstrap_database keeps every provider on .bootstrap-supabase.mjs (refused dispatching neon to .setup-app-role.mjs: grep 'ROW LEVEL SECURITY|CREATE POLICY' returns nothing there, so app #2 would ship 0 policies), and a new gate .claude/scripts/lib/verify-apprw.mjs runs against the exact URL about to be deployed. Live evidence, neon: {"user":"app_rw","bypassrls":false,"policies":14,"sslmode":"require","plaintext":"refused","guc":"__probe__"}; self_hosted: same with pg_stat_ssl true and policies 17. provision.py exits if any assertion fails, so 'role postgres - WARNING: BYPASSRLS' is unreachable.
